}}'''Corvila''' is a weaver who was taken ''[[gai'shain]]'' by the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Corvila}}

== Appearance ==
She is a lean woman.

== Activities ==
Corvila was one of the ''gai'shain'' who has sworn an oath of fealty to [[Faile Bashere]]. It is assumed that she has been freed with the dispersion of the Shaido and traveling with [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army.
